---
title: "A wrapper the document defines"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  code-window:
    wrapper: my-window
---

```{=typst}
#let my-window(content, ..args) = block(stroke: 1pt, content)
```

The document defines the wrapper itself, so the extension keeps that
definition and still writes the helpers that the hot-fixes call.

```{.python filename="a.py"}
x = 1
```
